title: Amplified decision value
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, a Boolean input $x$, a natural number $T$ of steps, a function $d:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, natural numbers $i,c$, and $v\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define the value to be the probability that applying $d$ to $c$ plus the number of accepting blocks among $i$ blocks of length $T$ yields $v$, when the random choice string has length $iT$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the random probability distribution and block-counting function, so their exact meanings cannot be specified.
